paths.name: @/lib/supabase/server
paths.message: Pure selector/helper modules must stay Supabase-free.

paths.message: Pure selector/helper modules must stay Supabase-free.

paths.name: @/lib/supabase/storage
paths.message: Pure selector/helper modules may only use pure helpers such as getRecipeImageUrl().

patterns.message: Pure selector/helper modules must not import hooks.

paths.name: @/lib/supabase/client
paths.message: Components must not access the Supabase client directly. Move DB access into a hook.

paths.name: @/lib/supabase/server
paths.message: Components must not access Supabase directly.

paths.name: @/lib/supabase/admin
paths.message: Components must not access Supabase admin helpers directly.

paths.name: @/lib/supabase/storage
paths.message: Components must use useRecipeImageStorage() for Supabase-backed image mutations. getRecipeImageUrl() remains allowed because it is pure.
